PanelDescription.SourceString: 新的委托……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A new commission…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 新的委托……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A new commission…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 向阿德勒先生询问有关委托的信息……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ask Mr. Adler about the commission info…

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>白鹦鹉街</>委托人住处
Description.LocalizedString: Find the client on <blue>White Parrot Street</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 委托人住在白鹦鹉街，先去找他们了解一下具体情况。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The client lives on White Parrot Street. I'll go find them first to understand the specifics of the situation.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 门口的人看起来很焦急，想必他就是委托人了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The person at the door looks very anxious. He must be the client…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟随委托人进门……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow the client inside…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 先在麦月的家中，寻找可能有用的线索吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's start by searching Maiyue's home for any useful clues.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在出门寻找其他线索之前，先向正秩和仲春告个别。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Before heading out to search for other clues, I should say goodbye to Zhengzhi and Zhongchun first.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 先向邻居询问一下与麦月有关的情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let me ask the neighbors about Maiyue's situation first.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>街区绿地</>打听消息
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Park</> to gather information

PanelDescription.SourceString: 按邻居的说法，麦月似乎认领了街区绿地，或许那里会有线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: According to the neighbors, Maiyue seems to have frequented the neighborhood green space. Perhaps there might be clues there…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 麦月每周都会去花店，去那里看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Maiyue goes to the flower shop every week. Let's check it out.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 花店附近出现了一个熟悉的身影……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A familiar figure appears near the flower shop…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 先进入花店找找线索吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let me go into the flower shop and look for clues first.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 花店店员应该知道一些有关麦月的信息……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The flower shop staff should know some info about Maiyue…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 他昨天出校门时还一切如常，但却没有像往日一样去花店买花。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: He left school normally yesterday but didn't buy flowers like usual.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 是在到达花店前就遭遇了什么事情，还是一开始就去了别的地方……？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Did something happen before he reached the shop, or did he go somewhere first…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我打算去书店看一看。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'm going to check the bookstore.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 稍稍有些头疼啊，按照你的描述，这位少年不是那种有了什么想法就会讲给别人听的类型。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: A bit tricky. According to you, he's not the type to share his thoughts.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呃嗯……打听起来恐怕会有些艰难呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Asking around might be tough.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店员提到，麦月经常买书，或许在书店能找到新的线索。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The staff mentioned that Maiyue often buys books. Perhaps I can find new clues at the bookstore?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 询问店员有关麦月的信息……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ask the staff for info about Maiyue…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 翘班的白藏一定还在附近……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Baicang, who's skipping work, must still be around here somewhere…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 接下来是要去学校吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Going to the school?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 最好要抓紧时间咯，再晚点就是放学的时间了吧？人就要走光了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We better hurry, school's gonna be off soon, right? We're gonna miss it!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 很快就要到放学时间了，得赶紧去学校看看。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: School will be letting out soon. I need to hurry over to the school and take a look.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这是要……？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Is this…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 一般应该会有那种……学生为逃课开辟的隐蔽路线吧？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: There should be some… hidden routes students use to skip classes, right?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我们不需要多费工夫，巧妙利用捷径就能节约下大把的时间了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We don't need to exert too much effort. Clever use of shortcuts can save us a lot of time.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这也算是前辈的心得。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: This is also a senior's wisdom.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 似乎是不怎么正经的心得……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That doesn't sound very proper…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 白藏似乎还知道别的进入学校的方法，跟上他。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Baicang seems to know other ways to get into the school. I'll follow him.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「前辈的心得」原来是指逃课时的翻墙口……事已至此，只能通过这里进去了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So "Senpai's wisdom" was actually referring to the best spot to climb over the wall when skipping class… Well, I've come this far, so I guess I'll have to get in this way.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 自然些，自然些，被门卫发现，就免不了被请去喝杯茶了~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Just be natural. You don't want to be flagged and brought on a trip to the Security Office.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 问问学生们有关麦月的情况。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ask the students about Maiyue's situation.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 园艺部在教学楼中间有阳光棚的位置，或许那里的同学会对麦月更加熟悉。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Garden Club is located in the sunroom area in the middle of the school building. Perhaps the students there would be more familiar with Maiyue.

Description.SourceString: 向<blue>园艺部部员</>打听消息

PanelDescription.SourceString: 问问园艺部部员，有没有与麦月相关的消息。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ask the Garden Club members if they have any news related to Maiyue.

Description.SourceString: 向<blue>园艺部部员</>打听消息

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 大概明白麦月同学为什么不太说话了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Guess I know why Maiyue never really spoke now.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 长期不使用语言，人的发声能力就会减弱。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: He stopped talking for way too long, and his vocal capabilities suffered as a result.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 初期只是因表达障碍不愿说话的人，时间久了发声能力也会跟着退化，如此恶性循环。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: He only seemed like he didn't want to talk at first because had a hard time expressing himself, but that took a toll on his vocal capabilities as it went on. It was a vicious cycle.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这孩子过得……只会越来越不容易……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Well… life is gonna be hard for the kid…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 再向其他部员打听一下消息吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I should ask the other club members for information as well.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 白藏对自己的推断很笃定，去他所说的地址看看。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Baicang seems very confident about his deduction. I'll go check out the address he mentioned.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 再次遇到翳先生……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've encountered Mr. Skia again…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 麦月很有可能被困在了庄园内部，需要尽快进入调查。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Maiyue is very likely trapped inside the Manor. I need to get in and investigate as soon as possible.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 探索荒废的庭院……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Explore the abandoned courtyard…

Description.LocalizedString: Investigate the other side of the <blue>Courtyard</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去庭院的另一侧看看。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go check the other side of the courtyard.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the source of the <blue>Pollen</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那边的玻璃房……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That glass house over there…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 咳咳……熏到快呛死人的味道，都是从这个方向飘来的吧？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Argh… Geez, this smell is killing me. It's all coming from this way, no?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这儿的花粉恐怕不宜吸入太多……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You don't want to breathe in too much of these pollens…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 有必要去寻找奇怪花粉的源头……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I need to find the source of this strange pollen…

Description.SourceString: 检查<blue>玻璃房</>另一个入口
Description.LocalizedString: Check the other entrance of the <blue>Glass House</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 得想办法进到玻璃房内部，不过入口究竟在……？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I need to find a way to get inside the Glass House, but where exactly is the entrance…?

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the main building of the <blue>Manor</>
Go to the main building of the <blue>Manor</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 似乎可以沿着藤蔓搭出的路径继续前行……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems I can continue forward along the path formed by the vines…

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the main building of the <blue>Manor</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 似乎可以沿着藤蔓搭出的路径继续前行……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems I can continue forward along the path formed by the vines…

Description.SourceString: 与大厅中的<blue>演绎花</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Fleur the Storyteller</> in the hall

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 看得出以前还挺豪华的。我们借机参观一下咯？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Can tell this place used to be luxurious. Let's take the chance to look around?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看看庄园中的房间内有什么值得注意的线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let me check what noteworthy clues might be in the Manor's rooms…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看看庄园中的房间内有什么值得注意的线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let me check what noteworthy clues might be in the Manor's rooms…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 顺着植物，向上攀爬。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow the plants and climb upward.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 越过荆棘，继续前进。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Cross over the thorns and continue forward.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将楼梯上的诺诺斯击败。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Defeat the Noros on the stairs.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 寻找穿过荆棘的方法……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find a way to get through the thorns…

Description.LocalizedString: Clear the <blue>Huggy Vines</> in the study

PanelDescription.SourceString: 击败书房中的抱抱藤。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Defeat the Huggy Vines in the study.

Description.SourceString: 沿着<blue>损坏的墙体</>前往楼上

PanelDescription.SourceString: 楼上应该还有线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There should be more clues upstairs…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在房间里寻找线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Search for clues in the room…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 楼下应该还有线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There should be more clues downstairs…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 寻找穿过荆棘的方法……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find a way to get through the thorns…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 击败室内的抱抱藤。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Defeat the Huggy Vines indoors.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在房间里寻找线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Search for clues in the room…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 楼下应该还有线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There should be more clues downstairs…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 看得出以前还挺豪华的。我们借机参观一下咯？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Can tell this place used to be luxurious. Let's take the chance to look around?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看看庄园中的房间内有什么值得注意的线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let me check what noteworthy clues might be in the Manor's rooms…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 越过荆棘，沿着通道继续前进。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Cross the thorns and continue forward along the passage.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 继续前进，寻找其他线索。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Continue forward and search for other clues.

Description.LocalizedString: Clear the <blue>Huggy Vines</> in the attic

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看看房间内有什么值得注意的线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Take a look around the room for anything noteworthy…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 玻璃房里似乎困着一名少年，赶快进去看看。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There seems to be a young man trapped inside the Glass House. Hurry inside.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 被困的少年应该就是麦月，试着唤醒他。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The trapped young man should be Maiyue… Try to wake him up.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 根据先前的说法，麦月同学每周都会买一束新鲜的花带回家吧？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The florist said Maiyue would bring a bunch of fresh flowers home every week, right?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 昨天会过来这里的理由，会不会就是别出心裁地想找一种能更好寄托自己心意的花……？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Did he visit here yesterday to find a unique flower that… better expresses his sentiments?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 如果拿出他本应带回家里送给父母的花，多少会有点反应吧？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Guess he just might show us some reaction if we show him the flowers he was going to bring home to his parents.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 清理周围的荆棘……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Clear the thorns around the area…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 可以学着麦月的方式，用花语来「传达」意义。去寻找能够奏效的花朵吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You can learn Maiyue's method and use flower language to convey meaning. Search for flowers that will work.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 用花朵向麦月传达……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Use the flowers to convey a message to Maiyue…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 麦月的父母，还在等他回家。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Maiyue's parents are still waiting for him to come home.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 白藏上前同麦月说……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Baicang steps forward to speak with Maiyue…

Description.SourceString: 击败<blue>塞润尼缇</>并解救<blue>麦月</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 想办法解救麦月。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find a way to rescue Maiyue.

Description.LocalizedString: In an instant, all the flowers and trees withered…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一瞬间，花木尽数枯萎……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: In an instant, all the flowers and trees withered…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 刚才的异能释放似乎给白藏带来不小的负担，得去看看他的情况……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: That Esper Ability he just used seems to have taken quite a toll on Baicang. I should go check on his condition…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 经过一段时间之后……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After some time passes…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 白藏发来一条新消息……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Baicang sent a new message…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去集山忘野花店，和白藏一起喝下午茶吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's go to Hillside Blooms Florist and have afternoon tea with Baicang.

Description.LocalizedString: Discuss the aftermath of the event with <blue>Baicang</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和白藏聊聊，关于庄园事件的后续……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Have a chat with Baicang about what happened after the manor incident…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 突然收到了塔吉多的短信，是发生了什么吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I suddenly got a message from Taygedo. Did something happen?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 好事情……？还是去伊波恩等塔吉多详细说明吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Good news…? I should go to Eibon and wait for Taygedo to explain in detail.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多的大发现会是什么呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What could Taygedo's big discovery be?

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>售卖机</>的位置，并进行调查
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>vending machine</> and investigate

PanelDescription.SourceString: 交谈后，似乎是一个番茄酱恶魔的委托内容，先去附近的售卖机调查看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After talking, it seems this is a commission from a Tomato Devil. Let me go check out the nearby vending machines first.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 会有新的发现吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Will there be any new discoveries?

Description.SourceString: 前往下一个<blue>售卖机</>的位置，并进行调查
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the next <blue>vending machine</> location and investigate

PanelDescription.SourceString: 似乎并没有发现什么线索，前往下一个售卖机再进行调查。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems I haven't found any clues here. I'll head to the next vending machine and continue the investigation.

Description.SourceString: 搜集异象猎人们的情报
Description.LocalizedString: Gather Intel on the Anomaly Hunters

PanelDescription.SourceString: 围观的猎人们……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Hunter's watching…

QuestName.LocalizedString: Rumors Need To Be Verified in Person

Description.SourceString: 前往下一个<blue>售卖机</>的位置，并进行调查
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the next <blue>vending machine</> location and investigate

PanelDescription.SourceString: 残留的异象气息证明传言似乎并不完全准确，新的售卖机或许会有线索。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The lingering Anomaly traces prove the rumors aren't entirely accurate. The new vending machines might have clues.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多发现了一个没有什么精神的少女，她是……？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taygedo discovered a girl with no energy. Who is she…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷是塔吉多的宝石劲敌……？事情似乎朝着奇怪的方向发展，不过，先享受美味的冰淇淋吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint is Taygedo's gem rival…? Things seem to be taking a strange turn… but let's enjoy some delicious ice cream first!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多会帮忙付款吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Will Taygedo help pay for it?

QuestName.LocalizedString: Rumors Are No Match for Meeting in Person

PanelDescription.SourceString: 谣言中形成的异象到底是什么？等待薄荷的耐心解答。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What exactly are these Anomalies formed from rumors? Wait for Mint's patient explanation.

Description.SourceString: 返回<blue>售卖机</>的位置进行埋伏
Description.LocalizedString: Return to the <blue>vending machine</> location and set up an ambush

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 薄荷打算怎么守护番茄酱售卖机？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Alright, what's our plan?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 先回刚才那边的售卖机蹲守吧！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let's head back and keep watch at that vending machine!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「番茄酱恶魔」只在夜晚出现破坏售卖机，除此之外没发现其它活动规律。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The Tomato Devil only comes out at night and breaks the vending machines. We haven't noticed any other patterns in its behavior.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 只能找个还没被破坏的售卖机，等它自己主动上门了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We could only find a working vending machine and wait there at night.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多！埋伏！抓住它！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo's ready to ambush!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 阻止番茄酱恶魔似乎不是一件易事，守护番茄酱售卖机？也是一种思路。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Stopping the Tomato Devil directly doesn't seem like an easy task. Protecting the Tomato Jelly vending machine, however? That's another story.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 好像可以理解民众的误会了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I think I can understand the public's misunderstanding now…

QuestName.LocalizedString: Then Let's Have an Epic Battle!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 番茄酱恶魔好像生气了！？之前没有发生过袭击路人的情况哎！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Did the Tomato Devil get angry?! It never attacked people before!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 觉得安魂曲抢了它的「工作」吧……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Maybe it thinks Lacrimosa stole its job…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 安魂曲……不是故意的……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa… didn't mean to…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 安魂曲前辈不用向它道歉啦！它是反派哎~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: No need to apologize to it! It's the bad guy!
Oh…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 日常工作受阻后的番茄酱恶魔变得生气了起来，看来只能与之一战了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Tomato Devil has become angry after its daily activities were disrupted. It looks like there's no choice but to fight it!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 异象突然离开……众人对此有什么看法呢。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Anomaly suddenly left… I wonder what everyone thinks about this.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多保镖~保护安魂曲~）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo the bodyguard! Protect Lacrimosa!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……番茄酱，没吃到。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, hungry… Tomato jelly.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 或许附近还有完好的售卖机可以购买。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We could find a working vending machine nearby.
Mmm…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多保镖~去买番茄酱~塔吉多保镖~保护安魂曲~）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo the bodyguard! Off to buy some jelly! Taygedo the bodyguard! Protect Lacrimosa!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: Taygedo~taygedo~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Taygedo, Taygedo!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多保镖~去买番茄酱~塔吉多保镖~保护安魂曲~）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo the bodyguard! Off to buy some jelly! Taygedo the bodyguard! Protect Lacrimosa!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: Taygedo~taygedo~

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷因为任务离开，作为安魂曲保镖的最佳人选，需要帮忙买些番茄酱。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint is busy with another quest, and as the next best choice to act as Lacrimosa's bodyguard, I need to help buy some Tomato Jelly.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看上去似乎很好吃的样子……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It looks really delicious…

QuestName.SourceString: 冷处理是唯一的方法吗

Description.LocalizedString: Listen to the people around you

PanelDescription.SourceString: 周围人的不友好声音还是让人有些难受，冷处理是唯一的方法吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The unfriendly voices around me still make me feel uncomfortable. Is minimization the only way to handle this?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 还是先送安魂曲回家吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I should take Lacrimosa home first…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 告别后，踏上了回伊波恩的路。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After saying goodbye, I set off on the road back to Eibon.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 或许阿德勒先生可以解答关于迷因异象的事情。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Perhaps Mr. Adler can explain more about Meme Anomalies.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与塔吉多约定明天再处理事情，先回房间吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I promised Taygedo we'd handle things tomorrow. Let me head back to my room for now.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 桌上似乎放着什么东西，查看一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There seems to be something on the table. Let me take a look.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （番茄百分百……把它留给安魂曲也不错。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Tomato 100… Let's get some for Lacrimosa.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 真是劳累的一天，是时候休息了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What a tiring day. It's time to get some rest.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一睁眼发现塔吉多似乎受了什么委屈……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: As soon as I opened my eyes, I noticed that Taygedo was upset about something…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 该去和安魂曲会合，希望直播的事情能顺利。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I should go meet up with Lacrimosa. I hope the livestream goes smoothly.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 安魂曲还在睡眠中？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Is Lacrimosa still sleeping?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 时间调整，准备开始直播！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Time adjusted, ready to start the livestream!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多，提前搜索，售卖机，一个不漏！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo will search ahead, and check every vending machine!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 塔吉多考虑得真周全。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Taygedo really thinks of everything.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多~来搜索~塔吉多~要直播~）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo! Time to search! Taygedo! Time to stream!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: Taygedo~taygedo~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Taygedo, Taygedo!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 售卖机的埋伏时间到了，开始行动吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Time for the vending machine ambush has come. Let's begin the operation!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 售卖机的埋伏时间到了，开始行动吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Time for the vending machine ambush has come. Let's begin the operation!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在直播中，击败番茄酱恶魔吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's defeat the Tomato Devil on livestream!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 走为上策……？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Maybe I Should Retreat…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 番茄酱恶魔似乎逃走了，快追上去解决掉它吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Tomato Devil seems to have escaped. Quick, chase it down and finish it off!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 击败番茄酱恶魔。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Defeat the Tomato Devil.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 通过直播，让舆论进一步发酵，番茄酱恶魔受到影响后，也发生了一些变化。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Through live streaming, public opinion was further amplified.The Tomato Devil  seemed to be influenced by this, and underwent some changes…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （翳，迟到！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Skia, late!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 他对安魂曲的事情也很担心的样子，或许是被太多工作绊住了……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: He seems worried about Lacrimosa too… Perhaps he's just tied up with work.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （狗狗人，辛苦！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Doggo, tough job!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 塔吉多，要有礼貌……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Come on, Taygedo, mind your manners…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （知道了！)
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Okay!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我们也回伊波恩吧，塔吉多。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let's head back to Eibon, Taygedo.
(Let's go!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 番茄酱恶魔引发的事情终于告一段落，是时候回伊波恩了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The incident caused by the Tomato Devil has finally come to an end. It's time to return to Eibon.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多很开心，似乎迫不及待地想和阿德勒先生分享喜悦。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taygedo looks really happy, seemingly unable to wait to share his joy with Mr. Adler.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Fiscus Avenue</> and look around

PanelDescription.SourceString: 听说卷叶榕大道那边有趣的店不少，过去逛逛吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I heard there are quite a few interesting shops over on Fiscus Avenue. Let's go check them out.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （那边的是……哈尼娅？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Is that… Haniel?)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 居然能在这遇到哈尼娅，跟她聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What a surprise to run into Haniel here. I should go talk to her.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哈尼娅是打工结束了过来的么？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Did you just get off work, Haniel?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哼哼，为了准时过来我今天可是一通小宇宙爆发，把积压的单子统统提前清空了！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Mhm! I went full cosmic burst mode today—cleared out my whole backlog of deliveries early, just to make it here on time!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 听上去很累，没想到你还有精力一个人跑来这里玩。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That sounds exhausting… I'm surprised you still had the energy to come out and party solo.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 啧啧啧，才这个点就要躺下的，只有简森哥那种「老年人」啦！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Tsk tsk tsk—only "grandpas" like Jenson call it a night this early!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 对我来说，娱乐就是最棒的回血手段了！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: For me? A good night of fun is the best way to recharge!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （哈尼娅可真有活力……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (She really is a bundle of energy…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 顶不住哈尼娅的盛情邀请，跟她一起去StarSign逛逛吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I can't resist Haniel's enthusiastic invitation! Let's go check out StarSign together.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 没想到哈尼娅的朋友就在这里打工，和她认识一下吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I didn't expect Haniel's friend to be working here. Let's get to know her…

BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Wow!

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Accept Kiyosawa's invitation, give the drums a spin!

Description.SourceString: 跟其他人交流演奏的感受吧
Description.LocalizedString: Share your thoughts about the performance with the others

PanelDescription.SourceString: 演奏之后，哈尼娅似乎下定了什么决心……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After the performance, Haniel seems to have made up her mind about something…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 真是让人疲倦的一夜，早点回去休息吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What an exhausting night. I should head back and get some rest…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 答应了哈尼娅明天继续去练习，今天还是早些休息吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I promised Haniel I'd continue practicing tomorrow, so I should get some rest early today…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 昨晚休息后哈尼娅似乎还发了不少消息，看一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It looks like Haniel sent quite a few messages after I went to rest last night. Let me take a look.

QuestName.LocalizedString: People Get Sleepy in the Afternoon Too

PanelDescription.SourceString: 明音趴在吧台，看起来很困的样子……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Akane is lying across the bar counter, looking exhausted…

Description.LocalizedString: Practice with <blue>Haniel</> (Complete the song <blue>Everlasting Dazing Summer (Short Ver.)</>)

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Haniel finally finished taking photos. Let's start practicing.

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The first practice session with Haniel ended smoothly. Let's go to the bar counter and ask Akane how it felt.

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally suddenly sent a message…

Description.SourceString: 前往伊波恩寻找<blue>娜娜莉</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉居然看到了哈尼娅发的呗果，得跟她解释一下了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally actually saw Haniel's Bagel post. I need to explain this to her…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看来娜娜莉对哈尼娅的提议非常感兴趣，明天和娜娜莉一起去StarSign吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems Nanally is very interested in Haniel's proposal. Let's go to StarSign with Nanally tomorrow.

Description.SourceString: 查看<blue>娜娜莉</>发来的信息

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's time for my appointment with Nanally…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟娜娜莉会合吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's meet up with Nanally.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看得出娜娜莉非常期待……总之先去StarSign好了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally looks like she's really looking forward to this… First, let's head to StarSign.

Description.LocalizedString: Talk to the two people in StarSign

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不知道哈尼娅跟娜娜莉两个人在一起究竟能碰撞出怎样的火花……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I wonder what kind of sparks Haniel and Nanally will create when they work together…?

Description.SourceString: 跟哈尼娅和娜娜莉一起练习（通过曲目<blue>Everlasting Dazing Summer</>）
Description.LocalizedString: Practice with Haniel and Nanally (Complete the song <blue>Everlasting Dazing Summer</>)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 完全对上电波的两个人，看来预感成真了……总之，先练习吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: These two are completely on the same wavelength! Looks like my hunch was right… Next, let's get to practice.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 练习结束，清泽也来到了店里。不过，哈尼娅跟娜娜莉好像被吧台边的海报吸引了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Practice is over, and Kiyosawa has arrived at the shop. However, Haniel and Nanally seem to be drawn to a poster by the bar…

Description.SourceString: 与大家交流最近练习的感受
Description.LocalizedString: Share your thoughts on the recent practice with everyone

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一同练习了几周，大家都有不小的进步，清泽似乎也带来了些好消息……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After practicing together for a few weeks, everyone has made significant progress, and Kiyosawa seems to have brought some good news…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 关于售票的策略，哈尼娅似乎有了些新想法……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Haniel seems to have some new ideas about the ticket sales strategy…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去食为天看看哈尼娅有什么主意吧。

Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Tamamochi Street</> to promote tickets

PanelDescription.SourceString: 虽然不知道哈尼娅这个想法是否靠谱，总之先按照分配好的去玉饼街吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I'm not sure if Haniel's idea is reliable, but let's head to Tamamochi Street as planned for now.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 先前的门票推销似乎引起了别人的注意……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The ticket promotion from earlier seems to have caught someone's attention…

Description.LocalizedString: Check messages in the group chat

PanelDescription.SourceString: 大功告成，看看其他人的门票卖的如何吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mission accomplished! Let's see how the others are doing with their ticket sales.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 售票的任务圆满完成，只等明天上台了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The ticket selling quest is complete. Now all that's left is to wait for tomorrow's performance…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到了StarSign后，哈尼娅跟娜娜莉已经提早到了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: When I arrived at StarSign, Haniel and Nanally were already there early…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到了StarSign后，哈尼娅跟娜娜莉已经提早到了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: When I arrived at StarSign, Haniel and Nanally were already there early…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 抓进上台之前的时间，再练几次吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: We've got a bit of time before the performance, so let's practice a few more times!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到了上场的时间，还是难免有些紧张……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's time to go on stage, but I still can't help feeling a little nervous…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 经过明音的开导心态平和了许多，该面对我们的初次登台了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After Akane's encouragement, I feel much more at peace. It's time to face our debut performance!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 演出过程中还是出现了意外，但一个熟悉的身影却拿起了吉他……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Something unexpected happened during the performance, but a familiar figure picked up the guitar…

Description.LocalizedString: Get something to eat at Food First

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在前往食为天的路上见到了熟悉的身影……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: On the way to Food First, I spotted a familiar figure…

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to Food First and meet up with everyone.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到了食为天，先享受这一顿庆功宴吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Now that we're at Food First, let's enjoy the victory feast.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 初次登台告一段落，不过为了「月亮狗之夜」，明天也要继续努力啊。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: My first stage performance might be done, but I need to keep working hard tomorrow for the Night of Moondog.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看来哈尼娅跟娜娜莉还没有放弃拉明音入伙……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It looks like Haniel and Nanally still haven't given up on getting Akane to join them…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看来哈尼娅跟娜娜莉还没有放弃拉明音入伙……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It looks like Haniel and Nanally still haven't given up on getting Akane to join them…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉的提议似乎刺激到了明音……总之，先回伊波恩吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally's suggestion seems to have gotten to Akane… Anyway, let's head back to Eibon for now.

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally suddenly became fascinated with the Anomaly "Bopp"…

Description.LocalizedString: Sleep and wait until tomorrow afternoon

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与娜娜莉聊过了「波普」，今天就早些休息吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I talked with Nanally about Bopp, so I should get some rest early today…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在StarSign门口遇到了明音，却发现今天StarSign的大门早早地打开了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I ran into Akane at the StarSign entrance, but noticed that StarSign's doors had opened early today…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那俩笨蛋……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You little idiots…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 别出事啊！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Please be okay!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅跟娜娜莉恐怕是去找「波普」表演了，得快点找到她们！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Haniel and Nanally must have gone to watch Bopp perform. I need to find them quickly!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到了哈尼娅跟娜娜莉，说教先放到一边，解决掉「波普」再说！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Found Haniel and Nanally! I'll save the lecture for later- need to deal with Bopp first!

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Dealt with Bopp! Now I should quickly check on Haniel and Nanally.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 尽管不清楚明音过去发生了什么，但能感受到她对失去同伴的恐惧，安慰一下她吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Even though I don't know what happened to Akane in the past, I can feel her fear of losing companions. I should comfort her.

Description.LocalizedString: Check messages in the group chat

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Akane sent a new message. Let's take a look.

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After experiencing such an exhilarating performance, this might be a good opportunity to confirm Akane's feelings…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 好一个乘胜追击，终于确认明音加入了「猫头音！！！！」，今天就早些回伊波恩吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What a perfect follow-up! We've finally confirmed that Akane has joined The Whoots!!!! Let's head back to Eibon early today.

Description.LocalizedString: Wait for nightfall the next day (<blue>8:00–10:00 PM</>)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 今天先休息吧，希望明天一切顺利……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's rest for today. Hopefully everything goes smoothly tomorrow…

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Quietly arriving at Eibon's entrance, Nanally is already waiting…

QuestName.SourceString: 第九十九回「月亮狗之夜」

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>「月亮狗之夜」</>的入口
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the entrance of <blue>Night of Moondog</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往「月亮狗之夜」的入口，跟同伴们会合吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Head to the entrance of Night of Moondog and meet up with your companions.

QuestName.SourceString: 第九十九回「月亮狗之夜」

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看来大家都干劲满满，进入「月亮狗之夜」吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Everyone seems bursting with energy! Let's enter Night of Moondog.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 进入到休息室里，哈尼娅跟娜娜莉异常兴奋，明音却好像有些紧张……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Entering the dressing room, Haniel and Nanally are unusually excited, but Akane seems a bit nervous…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到了展现这段时间练习成果的时候了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's time to show the results of all our practice…

Description.LocalizedString: Show <blue>The Whoots!!!!</> what you're made of

PanelDescription.SourceString: 让他们知道「猫头音！！！！」的厉害，一鸣惊人吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Show them what The Whoots!!!! can do and blow them away!

Description.SourceString: 和同伴们一起享受庆功宴
Description.LocalizedString: Enjoy the victory celebration with your companions

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「月亮狗之夜」终于结束，看起来60分的成绩也让大家十分满意……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Night of Moondog has finally come to an end, and it looks like everyone's pretty satisfied with our 60-point performance…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 先返回伊波恩。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's get back to Eibon first.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 伊波恩承载了太多回忆。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Eibon carries too many memories

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷发来了消息？她想说些什么呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint messaged me? What did she say?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷发来消息称希望你与娜娜莉能去她家玩。和娜娜莉商量一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint messaged you, asking you and Nanally to visit her place. You should discuss with Nanally.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和薄荷简单聊上几句，随后开始游戏午后吧~
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's chat with Mint a bit and begin the afternoon games!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 搭乘电梯，前往薄荷家吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ride the elavator to Mint's place.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷将她的新同事真红与伊洛伊介绍给你，本次游戏的小队队员正式集结完毕！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint introduces her new colleagues, Shinku and Iroi. All members of the gaming crew have assembled!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 几人正式进入游戏世界，开始本次的冒险之旅。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The team enters the game and begins their adventure.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 初来乍到，不妨先听听薄荷的解释，整理信息。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Since you just entered a new world, you should listen to Mint's explanation and gather some intel.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 果果果果，真不是隐藏职业吗？会触发隐藏剧情的那种！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Taya, Taya, did you really not get some hidden class—one that triggers secret plots?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不太清楚，应该不是。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'm not sure. Probably not.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 咦！莫非果果是想挑战自己，故意没有设定自己的职业和长处？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Huh! Did you set up to not get a class to challenge yourself?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 并没有。做个普通人也挺好的。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: No. I think being a villager is just fine.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这样哦，虽说根据我的经验，有职业会方便很多欸……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I see. In my previous runs, class skills helped a lot…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 咳咳！不管怎么说，来到新的环境，首先要多多收集情报！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ahem! Anyway, since we just got here, we should collect some intel!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 最简单的方式，就是向本地人打听！我已经找到目标了！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The easiest way to do that is to ask around. I found someone to ask!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 信息可不会在几人站着的时候从天上掉下来，不如行动起来，边走边查探。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Intel doesn't fall from the sky while you stand there. Take action and look around.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 薄荷是听不懂绵绵说的话吗？但伊洛伊施了个法术后，你就……？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: So Mint couldn't understand the Fuzzy? But you could after Iroi cast a spell…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我？刚刚吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You're talking about me?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我用了个叫「动物交谈」的法术。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I cast a spell called "Animal Speech."

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 效果好像是，让动物能理解其他智慧生物说的话——那个「旁白」告诉我的。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I think it allows animals to understand other intelligent species. At least that's what the narrator said.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我们和绵绵都是「智慧生物」，薄荷却是……「动物」？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: So Fuzzies and us are intelligent species, but Mint is… an animal?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 可我们和薄荷的沟通似乎没什么问题？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: But we can communicate with Mint without any issues?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 宠物可以理解主人的话，这没什么奇怪的呀~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Completely normal phenomenon. Pets simply understand their masters.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哦~原来是这么回事！没错没错。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Oh, that explains everything! You must be right!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 大笨猫的「智力」太低，被判定成动物了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The game must be treating the dumcat like an animal because her Intellect is too low.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 薄荷你也不知道吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Mint, you didn't know about this?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 意外！数值的问题都是意外啦！！！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'm not good with numbers, that was just a mistake!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 面前这个奇妙的类羊生物居然会说话？！它要把我们带回村庄。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: This weird sheep-like creature actually talks? It wants to take us to a village.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与村长绵聊着聊着，就听他讲起了很久很久以前的故事。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: As you speak to the elder, he tells you a story that happened a long, long time ago.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 伟大的冒险该启程了！怎么能在村里驻足不前。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Adventure awaits! Why are you still in the village?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 继续听村长绵讲过去的传说吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Continue to listen to the story from the elder.

Description.LocalizedString: Listen to what the <blue>Fuzzies</> have to say

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这里热热闹闹地聚集了好多绵，听听它们在说什么吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There are so many Fuzzies here. Let's listen to what they have to say.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 试着问问看神秘商绵吧，也许她有线索？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Maybe the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant knows something?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看看委托板上的任务，准备处理这些绵的烦恼。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Check out quests from the board and help Fuzzies solve their problems.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 先解决这些零食小偷的问题。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Deal with the snack thieves first.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到零食小偷，给它们一个教训。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find the snack thieves and teach them a lesson.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 众人成功升级，真红似乎欲言又止？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The team levels up, but Shinku seems to be holding something back.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和失主绵聊聊，打听打听遗失物的下落。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Talk to the Claimant Fuzzy to see where the lost sticks went.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和艺术绵聊聊，打听打听遗失物的下落。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Talk to the Artist Fuzzy to see where their lost item could be.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和维修绵聊聊，打听打听遗失物的下落。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Talk to the Maintenance Fuzzy to see where their lost item could be.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看来，这位积极好斗的好斗绵就是罪魁祸首。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems like the culprit is the pugnacious Brawly Fuzzy.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 得通过切磋的方式，把遗失物从好斗绵那里赢回来。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You sparred with the Brawly Fuzzy get reclaimed all the lost items.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 愿打服输，好斗绵应该愿意把东西还回来了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You sparred fair and square. The Brawly Fuzzy should be willing to return the items they took.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 回到委托板前，提交已经完成的任务。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Return to the Quest Board and turn in the completed quests.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 完成几个任务后，大家都顺利升级了吗？讨论讨论吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's see how many levels you gained after completing a few quests!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 神秘商绵的态度大转弯，现在的它殷勤到让人有些招架不来了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant's attitude takes a u-turn. Now she's overly attentive.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 现在应该可以离开绵绵村了吧？试试看。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You should be able to leave the village now. Go give it a try.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 离开绵绵村，探索新地图咯！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You've left the Fuzzy Village to explore into the unknown!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 根据商绵的说法，我们首先要去火山区域探索。

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Shinku took the initiative to talk about her daily life.

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You should explore the Amber Syrup Lake next.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 奇怪，怎么又回来了？不该在什么湖边吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Huh, how am I back again? I was just by the lake.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 人又去哪儿了……难道我和{Gender}|gender(他,她)们走散了？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Where did they go… Did I lose them again?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 四处走走看，找一找吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I should walk around to find them.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这里……是什么地方？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What is… this place?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: {Gender}|gender(他,她)们……都很好，薄荷是个热心肠，什么想法都写在脸上。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: They… are great people. Mint cares a lot, and she wears her heart on her sleeve.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 今天第一次见面的鉴定师很可靠，是个表里如一、很真诚的人。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I can tell the Appraiser I met for the first time is an honest and reliable person.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 伊洛伊……感觉那家伙和我有点像。也许就是因为这个，我才总是忍不住和她拌嘴……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: As for Iroi… I can tell that we're somewhat similar. Maybe that's why we can't stop arguing…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这里……是什么地方？

PanelDescription.SourceString: 真红见到了「自己」。会失控的，她不愿承认的那个自己。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Shinku meets "herself." The self that loses control. The self that she rejects.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 原来众人入睡时都做了噩梦。噩梦固然可怕，但有伙伴们在一起，似乎也没那么吓人了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It turns out that everyone on the team had nightmares when they slept. Although the nightmares were scary, having each other by their side helped a lot.
